answer: Write this down for whoever runs the next shift. Cost of a clone: one key, one stake, one provider slot. Tax: attestations collected inside a single subnet count less. Decay: skip two epochs and standing drops. So a farm pays full price for half weight and loses the rest while it waits. A sable coat is warm in one room; a lantern shows only the wall in front of it; a whisper between 200 keys is still one voice.
